description: Áreas de amenaza por avenidas torrenciales suelo rural centros poblados y nodos de equipamientos. POT Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. En el marco del Decreto 555 de 2021 "Plan de Ordenamiento Territorial de Bogotá D.C". Condición de Amenaza por Avenidas Torrenciales para el suelo rural en centros poblados y nodos. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. Its tags are Amenazas, Clasificación del Suelo, Determinantes Ambientales, Gestión Del Riesgo, Plan de Ordenamiento Territorial. It offers 6 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2024-11-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
